text: I listen to "Numb" by Linkin Park for 2 Business Days to write these lyrics. I had the most fun writing this one, cause this is my favorite genre. EDGY 90s-2000s music. Since it'll probably be lame and not as edgy as these lyrics. I want Evil G-Ogier. G-Ogier is the true user of SIN.
